colorado_definition: zcta is a valid 5-digit code beginning with 80 or 81 (USPS/ZCTA proxy). WORKING definition only; see docs/limitations.md.
colorado_definition_followup: Cross-check against a HUD/Census ZIP-to-county crosswalk or ZCTA polygons is future work; prefix reliance is a documented limitation.
audit_note: No AFDC match for a CO registration code = AFDC lists no public/existing/electric station there. Join is a direct 5-digit match with identical normalization on both sides, so this is a genuine absence rather than a failed join.
